observations.text: Every hero card exposes the same pair: 'Try it now!' -> /models/<id> (playground) and 'See docs' -> /models/<id>/api. Try-it and API are two tabs of one model page, not two products.
Cards carry task tags (text-to-image, image-to-video ...) plus capability tags (stylized, typography, lipsync, realism) and a 'new' badge.
Search chips are canned natural-language queries (/explore/search?q=...).
Gallery is task-first: the primary facet is input->output modality, the model vendor is secondary (Labs pages /explore/<vendor>).
